title: AgentRunRequest
description: A governed request to run a bounded agent on the shared agentic-bot plane (OpenClaw/Hermes-style runtimes are CANDIDATES behind harness_provider; the deterministic local emulator is the correctness invariant). Deny-by-default: an explicit allowed_tools/allowed_skills allowlist plus a forbidden_tools denylist, a sandbox_policy, a secret_policy (refs only — never values), a memory_policy, bounded max_steps + wall-clock timeout_ms, and require_receipt to force an AgentRunReceipt. The agent DISCOVERS/ACTS and PROPOSES; Baltor STORES/VERIFIES/RECONCILES — the run's output is never served truth. No raw secrets: pass env:// refs in secret_policy, never inline credentials; scope the input by reference (input_ref) when large or sensitive.

run_id.description: caller-assigned idempotency/correlation id for this run

product_id.description: owning product (e.g. baltor) submitting the run through the shared plane

tenant_id.description: owning tenant; tenant-private lineage never becomes global

agent_profile_id.description: id of the agent profile/persona being run (bounded role, not an open-ended self-rewrite)

harness_provider.description: id of the agent-runtime/harness to provision onto (resolves to a runtime; OpenClaw/Hermes-style runtimes are candidates, local_emulator@v1 is the active correctness invariant)

input_ref.description: ResourceRef-style handle to the task input (preferred over inline); exactly one of input_ref or input is expected

input.description: inline task input when small + non-sensitive; exactly one of input_ref or input is expected

allowed_tools.description: explicit tool allowlist (deny-by-default — a tool not listed here cannot be invoked)

allowed_skills.description: explicit skill allowlist (progressive disclosure; agent-created skills enter as candidates, never auto-active)

forbidden_tools.description: explicit tool denylist; a tool here is rejected even if it appears in allowed_tools

sandbox_policy.description: an AgentSandboxPolicy by value (required/isolation_level/network_policy/no_host_exec_by_default) — deny-by-default execution boundary

secret_policy.description: an AgentSecretPolicy-style object: secret references only (env://<NAME>), NEVER secret values; resolved only at the runtime boundary by an authorized resolver

memory_policy.description: an AgentMemoryPolicy by value (scope/cross_tenant=false/writes_allowed) — cross-tenant memory is forbidden

max_steps.description: hard upper bound on agent steps (deny-by-default bound)

timeout_ms.description: hard wall-clock budget for the whole run in milliseconds

require_receipt.description: when true, the run MUST emit an AgentRunReceipt or be treated as unavailable
